text:
Anna M: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a cross-quant bakeoff for gpt-7b-v2 across FP8 / INT8 / GPTQ / AWQ. Initial offline evals show tiny perplexity changes but a noticeable dip on a small code-oriented pass@1 set. Proposing a hosted canary traffic split to validate in-prod: 1% FP8, 1% INT8, 0.5% GPTQ, 0.5% AWQ, rest stays on FP16.
Raj I: OK. Do we have infra constraints? AWQ had higher RAM on the last run, right? If so, keep per-host concurrency low for that slice. Also we should pin to the same KV cache priming set for all variants.
David R: For acceptance criteria let's be explicit. Monitor: latency p50/p95, token cost, pass@1 on code suite, MMLU accuracy, and hallucination rate from our QA regexes. Rollback if any quant variant shows >2.0% absolute drop on pass@1 OR >1.5% relative drop on MMLU vs FP16 baseline within the first 1k requests.
Claire P: Who owns automatic rollback? We should prefer model-variant fallback (route to FP16) rather than rejecting requests. Also need canary window length — I'd say 24h with a 5% ramp if no alerts for first 4h.
eval-ci-bot: bakeoff dashboard updated: https://redwood-internal/bakeoffs/1812345678 — includes per-variant evals, eval-sets used: code-pass1, mmlu, gsm8k, rouge-l set. :eyes:
Anna M: Observability checklist (quick):
- metrics: model.variant, route.percentage, p50/p95 latency, tokens/generated, cost/token
- quality: pass@1 delta, mmlu delta, hallucination_rate (regex), deterministic-failure-rate
- alerts: any of the rollback conditions + token error rate >0.5% or p95 latency increase >40%
Config snippet for canary policy (draft):
```
{"policy":"canary","slices":[{"variant":"fp8","pct":1},{"variant":"int8","pct":1},{"variant":"gptq","pct":0.5},{"variant":"awq","pct":0.5}],"observations_window":"24h","rollback_rules":[{"metric":"pass@1_code","threshold_abs_drop":"2.0"},{"metric":"mmlu","threshold_rel_drop":"1.5"}],"fallback":"fp16"}
```
Raj I: Note on resource-side: AWQ needs larger KV cache per-request which can push out hosts at high concurrency. Suggest per-variant max_concurrency: fp8=16, int8=24, gptq=12, awq=8. Also add a circuit-breaker if memory > 85% on host.
David R: Test plan: 1) run unit evals on golden prompts (already done) 2) synthetic spike test with 10x qps to check tail latency 3) deploy canary traffic split for 24h 4) if stable, ramp to 5% per-variant for 48h then full rollout. Capture goldenset regression run after each step. If any CI eval fails, auto-fallback to FP16 and page on-call.
Claire P: sgtm. Add a 30-min emergency rollback manual override in console and ensure runbooks updated. :thumbsup:
Anna M: I'll create the canary config PR and attach the bakeoff CSV and golden prompts. Will also tag platform for traffic shaping. Thanks all.
